radius.$description: Theme-independent shape semantics. Persistent controls and containers use broad roles; specialized transient surfaces keep their own optical corner roles.

control.$description: Corner radius for interactive controls: buttons, inputs, chips.

container.$description: Corner radius for surfaces that contain other content: cards, panels, dialogs.

menu.$description: Outer radius for compact floating menu surfaces.

menuItem.$description: Inner row radius for selectable commands inside floating menu surfaces.

pill.$description: Fully rounded. For badges and toggles whose shape is part of their meaning.

border.$description: Border widths. Authored in px because a hairline should stay a hairline.

material.$description: Half-pixel optical outline for translucent floating materials.

focusRing.$description: Thickness of the focus indicator. Paired with color.focusRing.

focusRingOffset.$description: Gap between the control's edge and its focus ring.
